title: Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness
subtitle: Tactical 3D dungeon crawl battling a creeping cosmic darkness across the realm of Daren
tagline: Step through the shadow gate and claim your destiny
loreSummary: You are the Champions of Daren, sworn to repel an ancient malevolent Darkness rising from the Dead Irall. Armed with elemental action runes, delve into treacherous 3D multi-level dungeons and make fateful decisions that shape the survival of the realm.
keyFeatures: Action cube management system balancing powerful combat abilities with creeping curse cubes
Modular 3D multi-level dungeon terrain with line-of-sight and verticality mechanics
Dynamic Darkness mechanic actively spreading across the battlefield, draining life and buffing monsters
Branching narrative choices and interactive story interludes tracking moral decisions

drunagor_core.name: Core Age of Darkness Campaign
drunagor_core.description: The complete 18-adventure narrative campaign across Daren from Blackriver to the heart of the Darkness.

drunagor_extended.name: Core Campaign & Side Quests
drunagor_extended.description: The full core saga enhanced with supplementary adventure quest modules like the Ruins of Luccanor.

drunagor_grand_saga.name: Grand Saga (Core + Apocalypse)
drunagor_grand_saga.description: An epic 34-adventure odyssey combining the entire base campaign with the massive 16-adventure Apocalypse expansion.

milestones.title: Shadows Over Blackriver
milestones.phase: Campaign Act I - The Encroaching Shadow
milestones.description: Investigating mysterious disappearances around Blackriver and halting the initial incursions of corrupted beasts at the outskirts of Daren.

milestones.title: Secrets of the Dead Irall
milestones.phase: Campaign Act II - The Blighted Groves
milestones.description: Venturing into the cursed depths of the ancient Irall forest to uncover lost runic lore and purge necrotic dark shrines.

milestones.title: Siege of the Fallen Keep
milestones.phase: Campaign Act III - Heralds of Despair
milestones.description: Breaching the corrupted citadel to confront high-ranking darkness generals and dismantle the malevolent soul-harvesting ritual.

milestones.title: The Dawn Over Daren
milestones.phase: Campaign Act IV - The Final Reckoning
milestones.description: Entering the abyssal nexus to sever the Darkness from the mortal realm, deciding the ultimate fate of Daren in an epic tactical climax.
